sloka: सर्वे च ते बाष्पकलाः साश्रुनेत्रा विचेतसः ।सम्मूढा इव दुःखेन त्यजन्तो राघवं तदा ।। ७.४०.२७ ॥
transliteration: sarve ca te bāṣpakalāḥ sāśrunetrā vicetasaḥ ।sammūḍhā iva duḥkhena tyajanto rāghavaṁ tadā ।। 7.40.27 ॥

translations.english: At that time, all of them, full of tears and with tearful eyes, were bewildered and stupefied by sorrow as they were leaving Rama.
